visual_review.identity: Deep cool charcoal-gray compact rocky soil, subdued gray embedded stone groups and sparse pale dry tufts. Cool dark-gray identity retained without black pools, lava, glow or cemetery objects.
visual_review.detail_density: About 20-24 distinct small accent groups, including 7 dry tufts. Broad soil values are quiet, with residual fine mottling and small ragged boundaries.
visual_review.scale_caveat: Most main stone faces span around 7-13 world units and tuft groups around 9-18 at the proposed 256-unit period; sparse but larger than the initial 2-6-unit guidance.
visual_review.style_caveat: Matte grouped stones and sparse tufts; soil remains more textured than the flat approved earth-plane reference. This is documented for scale review rather than changed by filtering.
visual_review.native_acceptance: Opaque/dimensions passed; catalog-only material candidate, no scene binding or seamlessness claim.
